name: dropdown-menu
useFor: Use for actions on one thing behind a single control (a site's or parcel's row actions), and for small option sets with DropdownMenuCheckboxItem (map layers) or DropdownMenuRadioItem (units). Mark a destructive action with variant="destructive" and keep it last, after a separator. A long menu fades at an edge (fade-y) where more items scroll past it.
constraints: Navigation between pages in a dropdown
More than one level of submenu
Rounded corners or a shadow on the panel
source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the review build's combobox and unit select lists (Bone cut frame, Stone line, Fog highlight), Figma UI · Inputs (442:107) for the frame and the checkbox (442:161) for the check

title: Dropdown Menu
description: A Bone panel with the 6px cut corner and a 1px Stone line, no shadow; square 32px rows, Fog under the highlighted row and Mist while pressed, section labels in the secondary ink, and Mireye's check at the end of a chosen row.
